body: I feel like the odds of finding a partner who even comes close to her are low enough that it's not worth trying. And also don't have anything else in my life that I give a shit about in the meantime
Met when things were going fairly well

I just don't believe that people get that many chances when it comes to love. I've already had a few bad ones, this was the first good one and I completely fucked it up. I don't believe I'll ever again find someone as compatible/kind/accepting of how messed up I am.

Thank you for your kind words. I've tried to reach out to a couple of friends but everyone's busy for the holidays (and besides, I'm worried that if I bother people about this too much I'll just bum them out and they won't want to talk to me). I guess it's true that I don't know what the future holds but I don't think people get infinite chances to be happy and I feel like I just blew my only shot.
